desc: Exteriors - moor, field, rooftop, anywhere exposed.
prompt: steady cold wind blowing across open ground, air moving over grass and low scrub, rising and falling in strength, no trees, no gusts hitting the microphone, outdoors
negative: music, tonal, speech, rain, thunder, birds, whistling
note: 'whistling' is load-bearing in the negative: wind prompts drift into a tonal whistle, and the moment it has a pitch it reads as a synthesiser rather than as weather. Safe to run long and loop - it has no periodicity to seam on. Sits under everything; wind is what makes an exterior stop sounding like a room.

evidence.method: nothing has checked this card against pixels
